description: This script handles uploading logs to a server, including TLS connection attempts, HTTP uploads, and cleanup operations. It is used for stress testing and log management in a device environment.

methods.name: uploadLog
methods.description: Logs messages with timestamp to a specified log file.

methods.name: logTLSError
methods.description: Logs TLS connection errors based on error codes.

methods.name: sendTLSSSRRequest
methods.description: Attempts to establish a TLS connection to a server using curl.

methods.name: HttpLogUpload
methods.description: Uploads logs via HTTP/HTTPS, including retries and S3 upload handling.

methods.name: uploadLogOnReboot
methods.description: Handles log packaging and uploading during reboot, with cleanup.
